access_links.label: ESRM20 on risk.EFEHR: viewers, input files and web services

description: The European Seismic Risk Model 2020 is a probabilistic seismic risk assessment of physical damage and loss to residential, commercial and industrial buildings and their occupants in Europe. It combines stochastic catalogues from the 2020 European seismic hazard model with a ground motion logic tree, a regional site response model, and exposure and vulnerability models, with calculations run in the OpenQuake engine and input files stored in GitLab. Results for 44 countries at national and first administrative level include average annual economic loss, 50 to 1000 year return period losses and average annual loss of life, explored in interactive viewers and through web services. Coverage: 44 European countries. Access: the risk.EFEHR platform hosted at EUCENTRE, the technical report by Crowley and others (2021) and the exposure and vulnerability repositories. Licence: CC BY 4.0; free. Caveats: efehr.org pages failed TLS checks here, so facts come from the EUCENTRE mirror; results reflect building stock around 2020. Simulation uses are European seismic loss benchmarks, input files for national models and comparison with global models. Related records: the European Building Vulnerability Database, the GEM global seismic risk map and the OpenQuake engine.
